port.description: TCP port Ganesha listens on. When exposed with network.ports[].expose: EXPOSE_VIP, keep it different from the exposed port (2049) and set it as target_port

pseudo.description: NFSv4 pseudo path clients mount, e.g. vip:/share

path.description: Exported directory, relative to the block's mountPath (never the volume root, which holds .nfs-state)

squash.description: Map client root (root), nobody (none) or every user (all) to the anonymous uid

gracePeriod.description: Seconds after a start or failover during which clients reclaim their opens and locks
